entities.summary: Salem Ilese Davern is an American singer-songwriter known for her singles "Mad at Disney" and "PS5". She has also co-written songs for artists such as Bella Poarch, Demi Lovato, and Illit. In 2019, she released her debut EP, 757 and in 2023, she released her debut album High Concept.
